text:
Maria G: FYI we have an external assessment (BlueSquall) booked for Wed 2026-05-06. Need to lock retest windows, ephemeral RBAC, log export/playback, and KMS scoping. Proposed windows: Wed 09:00-12:00 PT, Fri 13:00-17:00 PT. No kms:Decrypt for assessors.

Rahul S: +1 on deny decrypt. Provide presigned s3 exports & an STS-only role that allows s3:GetObject, logs:GetLogEvents, cloudwatch:DescribeLogStreams. Role TTL 90m; session policy per slot. Avoid kms:Decrypt. Do we need caller identity/key_id in exports?

Jon P: We should include request_id, principalId, and x-forwarded-for. For evidence integrity, sign tarballs and push sha256 into the ticketing entry.

Maria G: Agreed. Retention: default artifact retention is 14 days; propose 21 days for this engagement. If vendor needs longer we can extend to 30 on request.

Emily (oncall): We'll enable 10m debug sampling at start of each slot to capture headers. SIEM keeps original timestamps but ensure we don't re-ingest with altered times. I'll validate.

Rahul S: I'll draft an IAM role policy and session policy PR. Example assume snippet:

```
# assume role (assessor)
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessor-blue-squad --role-session-name bluesquad-1 --duration-seconds 5400

# presign export
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-exports/bluesquad/2026-05-06.tgz --expires-in 2592000
```

Rahul S: Policy will explicitly include "Effect": "Deny", "Action": "kms:Decrypt" for assessor principal. PR will have reviewers @Jon P and @Maria G.

pt-assess-bot: BlueSquad slot booked: 2026-05-06 09:00 PT. Contacts notified.

Jon P: Remediation flow: devs create a fix PR, attach a minimal repro, and upload a verification bundle (logs+traces+sha256) to /redprobe-fixes. Mark ticket with label "ready-for-retest". I'll be retest coordinator.

Maria G: Action items — Rahul: PR + presigned buckets by EOD Tue; Emily: dry-run export + SIEM timestamp check; Jon: retest checklist + ticket label automation. I'll author a 1-page runbook and link it here.

Emily (oncall): I'll run dryrun tomorrow 08:30 PT and paste sample checksum here.

Rahul S: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4821 — policy doc attached. Ping for walkthrough.

Maria G: Good work. If any assessor asks for decrypt, deny and ask them to use sanitized payloads. Escalate to #eng-oncall if role problems surface. :thumbsup:
